info.title: RocketMQ Rust AI SRE API
info.description: Canonical checked-in Phase 02 Control Plane and UI contract. Phase 02 adds typed alert, topology, forecast, simulation, readiness, notification and postmortem schemas while preserving the read-only RocketMQ boundary.

200.description: SSE stream containing WorkflowStreamEvent data frames
Bounded topology projection for correlated resources
Explainable multi-window SLO and eight-dimension cluster score
Deterministic cluster health including SLO, evidence, changes and incidents
Tenant and optional region health aggregated by worst cluster without averaging

internalToken.description: Internal SRE service token; accepted only by explicitly marked metadata operations.

EvidenceSnapshot.description: Immutable evidence captured from a queryable source.
EvidenceSnapshot.title: EvidenceSnapshot

AlertEvent.description: Sanitized alert event persisted before correlation.
AlertEvent.title: AlertEvent

AlertEvent__AlertEventId.description: Stable identifier for an ingested alert event.

AlertEvent__AlertSeverity.description: Stable alert severity independent of an upstream provider's spelling.

AlertEvent__AlertSource.description: Source that supplied an alert-like event.

AlertEvent__ClusterId.description: Internal identifier for an onboarded cluster.

AlertEvent__CorrelationKey.description: Deterministic first-pass key for bounded-window incident correlation.

AlertEvent__EvidenceId.description: Stable identifier for an evidence snapshot.

AlertEvent__ResourceKind.description: Resource classes accepted by the Phase 2 correlation engine.

AlertEvent__ResourceRef.description: Tenant-scoped resource identity used for correlation and topology lookup.

AlertEvent__SymptomFamily.description: Extensible symptom classifier. The value is a stable, lower snake-case ID.

TopologySnapshot.description: Immutable, bounded topology projection used by correlation and UI.
TopologySnapshot.title: TopologySnapshot

TopologySnapshot__AssetKind.description: Asset classes normalized into the topology graph.

TopologySnapshot__ClusterId.description: Internal identifier for an onboarded cluster.

TopologySnapshot__TopologyEdgeId.description: Stable identifier for a versioned topology edge.

TopologySnapshot__TopologyNode.description: One normalized node in a point-in-time topology snapshot.

TopologySnapshot__TopologySnapshotId.description: Stable identifier for an immutable topology snapshot.

ClusterHealthReport.description: Immutable, explainable health evaluation for one cluster.
ClusterHealthReport.title: ClusterHealthReport

ClusterHealthReport__BurnRateSeverity.description: Severity assigned to a configured multi-window burn-rate trigger.

ClusterHealthReport__BurnRateWindowResul.description: Evaluation of one configured short/long burn-rate window pair.

ClusterHealthReport__ClusterId.description: Internal identifier for an onboarded cluster.

ClusterHealthReport__EvidenceId.description: Stable identifier for an evidence snapshot.

ClusterHealthReport__HealthDataQuality.description: Explicit quality of the data used by a health evaluation.

ClusterHealthReport__HealthDimensionScor.description: Deterministic score and contributing SLIs for one health dimension.

ClusterHealthReport__HealthOperationalSt.description:
Operational context is carried independently so maintenance or drills do
not hide the underlying health severity.

ClusterHealthReport__HealthSnapshotId.description: Stable identifier for an immutable cluster health evaluation.

ClusterHealthReport__HealthStatus.description: Health result of an SLI, dimension, cluster, or fleet.

ClusterHealthReport__IncidentHealthSumma.description: Incident counts incorporated into the cluster overview.

ClusterHealthReport__SliHealth.description: Explainable multi-window result for one SLI.

ClusterHealthReport__SloDimension.description: Fixed health dimensions used by the deterministic Phase 2 score.

FleetHealthReport.description:
Tenant/region fleet view whose score and status are determined by the
worst cluster rather than an average.
FleetHealthReport.title: FleetHealthReport

FleetHealthReport__ClusterId.description: Internal identifier for an onboarded cluster.

FleetHealthReport__FleetClusterHealth.description: Bounded cluster summary used in fleet aggregation.

FleetHealthReport__HealthDataQuality.description: Explicit quality of the data used by a health evaluation.

FleetHealthReport__HealthOperationalStat.description:
Operational context is carried independently so maintenance or drills do
not hide the underlying health severity.

FleetHealthReport__HealthStatus.description: Health result of an SLI, dimension, cluster, or fleet.

CapacityForecast__EvidenceId.description: Stable identifier for an evidence snapshot.

CapacityForecast__ForecastId.description: Stable identifier for a capacity or backlog forecast.

BacklogEta__EvidenceId.description: Stable identifier for an evidence snapshot.

EvidenceSnapshot__ClusterId.description: Internal identifier for an onboarded cluster.

EvidenceSnapshot__CorrelationId.description: Identifier propagated across one logical SRE operation.

EvidenceSnapshot__CoverageStatus.description: Availability of a required signal or evidence source.

EvidenceSnapshot__EvidenceContent.description: Bounded evidence payload or a content-addressed reference.

EvidenceSnapshot__EvidenceExposure.description:
Read-only boundary through which an evidence snapshot was observed.

Exposure is transport metadata rather than source content, so it does not
participate in the canonical content hash.

oneOf.description:
Compatibility value for evidence captured before exposure metadata was
introduced.

EvidenceSnapshot__SchemaVersion.description: Version negotiation information for a serialized contract family.

EvidenceSnapshot__Sensitivity.description: Data handling classification applied before evidence leaves its source.

EvidenceSnapshot__TimeRange.description: Inclusive time range requested from an evidence source.
